# Communications Plan: Signal2Action RiskOps

## 1. Governance & Reporting Cadence
* **Daily Standup / Sprint Review:** Internal tracking across the 10-day capstone execution window to verify milestone completion per the Implementation Blueprint.
* **Weekly Management Summary:** Automated executive metrics report generated by the platform summarizing open vulnerabilities, active campaigns, and overdue remediation items[cite: 1].

## 2. Stakeholder Communication Channels
* **Security Leadership (CISO):** Weekly executive dashboard review and high-level risk exception approvals.
* **Application Owners:** Automated campaign notification emails and ticket sync updates.
* **Engineering / Architecture Repository:** GitHub commit logs, Pull Requests, and markdown documentation (`docs/`) serving as the single source of truth.
